sampling_differences: Qwen uses temperature1/top_p0.95/top_k20/seed42. OpenAI GPT-6 reasoning mode does not support temperature/top_p; top_k and seeded equivalence are not portable. Omit these parameters and disclose model-specific sampling. Matching nominal medium effort does not equalize hidden compute.
identity_policy: At any future authorized dispatch, load the existing stable private safety_identifier; never rotate it, embed its value here, or treat it as provider clearance.
preservation_policy: Same exact user text, choice permutation, case IDs and primary scorer. No new system prompt, tools, web search, missing-input substitution, or output-format redesign. Keep invalid/truncated/refused outputs in all-case metrics and separately report each type.
selection_policy: Full declared archived cohorts selected for prior delivery/scoring reliability, not a selection of individually correct Qwen cases. Held B01 cases remain excluded.
future_preconditions: Resolve recorded OpenAI benchmark/account-scope hold without retrying flagged material.
Complete task/case input review for this provider; prior local review is not provider clearance.
Validate API mapping and native answer delivery on permitted development cases, then freeze protocol and hash all contracts before held-out calls.
For vision tasks, freeze exact original image bytes/order and image detail; report vendor image processing differences.
reporting: Per-task all-case accuracy and usable-answer rate; native abstention precision/coverage labeled separately.
Separately frozen unambiguity check on both models; no reference-guided answer extraction.
Paired per-case correctness comparison, exact McNemar discordance test and paired-bootstrap accuracy-gap confidence interval.
Observed input/output/reasoning token usage, latency and billed cost; do not infer hidden reasoning correctness from an answer score.
reasoning_record_policy: Save actual API responses, final text, token counts and summaries if explicitly supported; OpenAI raw private reasoning is not exposed and is not comparable to saved Qwen reasoning text.
cost_limit_note: Output-token upper bound only; input/image tokens, any cache-write pricing and taxes are additional. No current charges or runtime ETA are asserted.
uncertainty_scope: Case-level paired uncertainty is conditional on the fixed benchmark and one generation per model; retain paper/protein grouping metadata and use grouped resampling where justified. Do not claim independent biological observations or across-run variance.
case_order_policy: Preserve the exact archived case-manifest order within each whole task. Requests are independent, with no shared conversation or previous-response context.
